questions.chapter: Chapter 5: Fault Tolerance, Recovery & Distributed File Systems (NFS, HDFS)
questions.text: Define a Distributed System. Explain its key characteristics: Heterogeneity, Openness, Scalability, Fault Tolerance, Transparency (Access, Location, Migration, Relocation, Replication, Concurrency, Failure).

questions.chapter: Chapter 3: Synchronization in Distributed Systems (Physical Clocks, Logical Clocks: Lamport, Vector, Mutual Exclusion)
questions.text: Explain the concept of Logical Clocks and Lamport's Happens-Before Relation ($a \to b$). What are the conditions for Lamport's Logical Clock? Explain Vector Clocks and how they capture causal relationships between events in distributed systems.

questions.chapter: Chapter 3: Synchronization in Distributed Systems (Physical Clocks, Logical Clocks: Lamport, Vector, Mutual Exclusion)
questions.text: Explain Distributed Mutual Exclusion algorithms: (a) Centralized Algorithm, (b) Distributed Algorithm (Ricart-Agrawala algorithm using timestamps), and (c) Token Ring Algorithm. Compare their message complexities, synchronization delays, and single points of failure.

questions.chapter: Chapter 4: Distributed Consistency, Replication & Consensus Algorithms (Paxos, Raft)
questions.text: State the CAP Theorem (Consistency, Availability, Partition Tolerance) and PACELC Theorem for distributed data stores. Explain Consensus in asynchronous distributed systems and the Raft / Paxos consensus algorithm.

questions.chapter: Chapter 6: Cloud Computing Models (IaaS, PaaS, SaaS, Public/Private Clouds, Virtualization)
questions.text: Explain Cloud Computing Service Models: Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS), Platform as a Service (PaaS), and Software as a Service (SaaS). Compare Public, Private, Hybrid, and Community Cloud deployment models.

questions.chapter: Chapter 6: Cloud Computing Models (IaaS, PaaS, SaaS, Public/Private Clouds, Virtualization)
questions.text: Explain Virtualization in Cloud Computing. Compare Type-1 (Bare-Metal) Hypervisor vs. Type-2 (Hosted) Hypervisor. Explain Full Virtualization, Para-Virtualization, and Operating System-Level Virtualization (Containers vs VMs / Docker & Kubernetes).

questions.chapter: Chapter 5: Fault Tolerance, Recovery & Distributed File Systems (NFS, HDFS)
questions.text: Explain the architecture of Hadoop Distributed File System (HDFS): NameNode, DataNodes, Secondary NameNode, Block Replication, Heartbeats, and Block Reports. How does HDFS ensure fault tolerance?

questions.chapter: Chapter 1: Distributed Systems Characterization, System Architectures & Models
questions.text: Explain the MapReduce Distributed Computing Paradigm (Map phase, Shuffle & Sort, Reduce phase). Write the pseudo-code for Word Count problem in MapReduce and trace the execution for a given text dataset across 3 nodes.

questions.chapter: Chapter 6: Cloud Computing Models (IaaS, PaaS, SaaS, Public/Private Clouds, Virtualization)
questions.text: Explain Service Level Agreements (SLA) in Cloud Computing. Explain Cloud Security challenges (Multi-tenancy isolation, Data encryption at rest and in transit, Identity and Access Management - IAM). Compare Monolithic Architecture vs. Microservices Architecture with API Gateways and Service Mesh.

questions.chapter: Chapter 1: Distributed Systems Characterization, System Architectures & Models
questions.text: Explain Election Algorithms in distributed systems: (a) Bully Algorithm, and (b) Ring Algorithm. Show the sequence of messages passed when the current coordinator process crashes.
